thread:
anya: ok team, exec asked for a 2-sprint pilot we can reliably ship to two mobile customers. need a trimmed scope decision now.
sam: what's the baseline constraints we must keep? (latency p95 target, cost saving floor, and eval slack)
mira: customers care about perceived latency and cost. they said 'no noticeable slowdown' and at least 20% token savings. they can accept small quality variance.
dan: technical note: aggressive quant (4-bit) helps costs but shows failures on long contexts. batching reduces cost but can increase tail latency if we wait too long.
lucy: ops: the last batch rollout produced a batch of truncated outputs for one customer. support load spiked. we need eval hooks and an emergency rollback path.
sam: trimmed MVP idea: 1) adaptive micro-batching (default 30ms, max 80ms), 2) server-side prefix KV caching hints for repeated flows, 3) conservative quant profile (8-bit) only for contexts <512 tokens; fallback to baseline. skip client-side caching for now.
mira: i like conservative quant. that'll reduce risk for payment/auth flows. we'll supply golden prompt sets for evals.
dan: acceptance criteria suggestion: median latency <= baseline+10%, p95 <= baseline+25%, token cost reduction >=20% on pilot traffic, eval-concordance >=0.97 on golden set, and <=2 SE escalations/week.
lucy: runbook requirements: monitoring queries, alert contacts, fast rollback steps, and customer comms template. i'll draft.
sam: rollout plan: feature flag + staged canary (10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h). if eval alert triggers, auto-rollback and notify #optimize-ops.
dan: eval-alert config prototype:
```
name: mobile-mini-pilot
eval_sets: [payments_short, onboarding_ui, search_short]
metrics:
  concordance: 0.97
  p95_latency_factor: 1.25
actions: [notify:#optimize-ops, rollback:true]
```
mira: i'll coordinate with customers (PulseApp, Sparrow) for traffic windows and golden prompts.
anya: decision: ship trimmed MVP (batching + server KV caching + 8-bit conservative quant) as default for pilot; keep 4-bit behind an experiment flag for internal test only. aim to ship MVP by end of sprint.
sam: i'll own feature flag rollout and dashboards (cost/token, per-route concordance, latency distributions). dan: i'll add quant-fallback tests to eval harness. lucy: support playbook & customer FAQ incoming. pipeline-bot: feature-flag scaffolding merged to staging at 1745234700.
anya: thanks. reconvene Thu to review runbook PRs and final golden sets.
